mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important discipline that is now gaining much attention in developing countries in view of the growing health burden, need for higher health expenditure in the midst of inadequate fund."

Health economics is an important discipline that is now gaining much attention in developing countries in view of the growing health burden, need for higher health expenditure in the midst of inadequate fund.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the one with the lowest total costs and in a situation where interventions are equal in cost, the better one is the one with highest effectiveness."
The best cost-effective intervention is the one with the lowest total costs and in a situation where interventions are equal in cost, the better one is the one with highest effectiveness.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the predominant expenditure for healthcare in Nigeria."
User fee (out-of-pocket expenditure) is the predominant expenditure for healthcare in Nigeria.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a way of summarizing the health benefits and resources used by competing healthcare programs so that policy makers can choose among them."
CEA is a way of summarizing the health benefits and resources used by competing healthcare programs so that policy makers can choose among them.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of a subset of goods and services that provides both psychic and monetary benefits to a consumer."
Healthcare is one of a subset of goods and services that provides both psychic and monetary benefits to a consumer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that different people will make different choices because their preferences, circumstances, and available information differ."
Rational behaviour means that different people will make different choices because their preferences, circumstances, and available information differ.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of a difficult market in economic analysis since ill-health determines the demand for healthcare services."
The Healthcare market is one of a difficult market in economic analysis since ill-health determines the demand for healthcare services.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an intangible action that is capable of satisfying human want - such services include healthcare services, waste disposal, health sensitization programmes etc."
A service rendered is an intangible action that is capable of satisfying human want - such services include healthcare services, waste disposal, health sensitization programmes etc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a pre-requisite if developing countries are to break out of the cycle of poverty."
Substantially improved health outcomes are a pre-requisite if developing countries are to break out of the cycle of poverty.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the price axis, while the horizontal axis is the quantity axis."
The vertical axis is the price axis, while the horizontal axis is the quantity axis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a mixed source of finance as it often draws contributions from both employers and employees and sometimes government."
Health insurance is a mixed source of finance as it often draws contributions from both employers and employees and sometimes government.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a condition in which it is impossible to satisfy all human wants for goods and services and this forms the central concept in economics."
Scarcity is a condition in which it is impossible to satisfy all human wants for goods and services and this forms the central concept in economics.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the measure of all final goods and services produced within an economy during a year."
Gross Domestic Product is the measure of all final goods and services produced within an economy during a year.

good
